pr_body:
This adds the function that sets the available contexts value per
connection object so that API user can set different available contexts
per connection.
The lifetime of such overriden value is the same as connection lifetime,
so on reconnection or device reboot all devices return to having the
same available contexts value again.

Fixes: #64968

issue_context.title: LE Audio: PACS: Set available context per device
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Currently the available contexts can be set as `bt_pacs_set_available_contexts`. However in a real world with a device that supports multiple connections, an application may want to set different contexts per device based on e.g. existing streams. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Implement another version of `bt_pacs_set_available_contexts` that takes a `struct bt_conn` similar to how `bt_conn_set_bondable` works with `bt_set_bondable`. 

The function should store the available context for that device, and also handle notifications on reconnections. There is no need to store this in settings, as on a device reboot it is fair that all devices return to having the same context again. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A
